data.text:
Sachin S/O Nanaji Lekkalwar vs The State Of Maharashtra 
Through Pso Mul ... on 8 August, 2024 
Author: Vinay Joshi
Bench: Vinay Joshi 
 
 1/2
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. 
 Criminal Application (Apl) No.1043 
 Sachin Nanaji Lekkalwar -Vs-State of Maharashtra
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office notes, Office Memoranda of
 Coram, appearances, Court's orders 
 or directions and Registrar's orders. 
 ------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. S.A.Mohta, Adv. for the applicant. 
 Mr. Amit Madiwale, A.P.P for non-applicant -State
 Coram Vinay Joshi &
 Mrs. Vrushali V. Joshi, J
 Date : 8th August, 2024. 
 1. Heard.
2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report No.204 of 2024 dated
13.05.2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 188,273,328 of the Indian Penal Code along
with Sections 26(2)(iv),30(2)(a),3,4 and 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered
with Police Station Mul, district Chandrapur. 
3.  It is argued that merely on the basis of statement of the co-accused, the applicant has been arraigned in the crime. Moreover, it is contended that the First Information Report is lodged by the police, which should be by Food Safety Officer and thus, there is no material to proceed.

1 Kavita 909 - apl 1043-24.odt 4. Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable in six weeks. 
5. Learned APP waives service of notice for non- applicant -State. 
6. In the meanwhile, investigation shall go on, but charge-sheet shall not be filed without leave of this Court. 
 JUDGE JUDGE Signed by: Kavita P Tayade Designation: PAKavita  To Honourable Judge Date: 09/08/2024 11:30:43 Sachin S/O Nanaji Lekkalwar vs The State Of Maharashtra Through Pso Mul ... on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179949045/
